sequence: Before exposure: original section, necessary precedents, immutable official original bytes and bounded raw calculation/method/evaluation receipts were independently inspected; no prior report bodies or author-added result explanation literals were read.
An own report generation attempt failed with SyntaxError in make_report.py due to an unescaped apostrophe in the draft scope string. It did not write the canonical report.

A dependent checker command was mistakenly placed after that failed command in the same shell without a success guard; it ran against the old canonical. Its saved stdout showed verdict-related validator messages from that old report.

Immediately after observing that output, substantive verification and verdict work stopped; coordinator notified. No correction or execution of the draft generator and no canonical overwrite followed exposure.

exposure: Old canonical verdict-related checker messages were actually printed/read. No claim of successful new report verification or continued independence is made.
